description: Zennify Digital Maturity Assessment tooling: the skills, agents and connector that produce and audit DMA Insights surfaces.

plugins.name: dma-insights
plugins.description: The six Digital Maturity Assessment skills, 77 DMA agents — 16 category researchers, a haiku evidence collector and a sonnet category orchestrator, a research challenger, a technographic scanner, report producers and validator, a five-agent scoring tier — the remote MCP connector (36 tools), the free open-source evidence engine with its SearXNG, Fetch, EDGAR, Parallel and alphaXiv connectors, and the research ENGINE: binding preflight, gating PRELIM, ERS, budget envelopes, watchdog.
